card.name: Clinical trial names in label text
card.fires_on: Trial acronyms such as MONARCH, SELECT, PROfound, and the opening bracket or space just before or inside them, in adverse reaction sections. It also appears in a few brand names like TRODELVY.

modes.label: Inside MONARCH trial names
modes.description: The ARCH piece of MONARCH or the space before a trial number.

modes.label: Bracket after trial name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a trial acronym that introduces the tumor type or the next trial.

card.writes: Pushes toward finishing odd name pieces and away from the word target.
card.plain: It fires when a drug label cites a named clinical trial, such as MONARCH or SELECT.
